home_hero_heading_primary: Let our team do the heavy thinking to formulate your brand's strategy, architecture, and design

home_hero_description_primary: Complex Design Studio is a Jakarta-based agency for website development, iOS and Android apps, UI/UX design, digital marketing, and product design, dedicated to building ready-to-use digital products from concept to production.
home_hero_description_secondary: We are committed to showcasing our excellence to the world, helping your brand reach the top and empowering UMKM (Indonesian Small and Medium Enterprises) toward success.
service_hero_center: Below are a few selected projects from our journey so far.
service_hero_right: Complex Design Studio is a Web Design, Mobile App, UI/UX Design, Website Development, Graphic Design, Printing Product, Motion & Slide, and Digital Marketing & SEO agency.
about_hero_center_primary: Complex Design Studio is a space where diverse skills from talented hands are forged into a single mind, a single purpose, one that always produces complex, quality work.
about_hero_center_secondary: Founded in 2015, built on the support of several teams united by a shared vision and mission. While our individual skill sets differ from one another, it is precisely this diversity that allows us to complement each other, adapt, and keep pace with the ever-evolving Digital World.
about_hero_center_tertiary: We operate on a solid and legitimate legal foundation under the auspices of PT Nikmat Agra Solusi. Over the years, we have grown into a professional agency that has provided extensive support to government institutions, State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN), and several major national corporations across Indonesia — while also helping to empower Small and Medium Enterprises (UMKM) in their growth journey.
about_hero_right: We don't sell hope. We deliver facts — a team that's genuine experts in this field.
